policy: The eight seeds and the candidate list are those of the round-2 head 9d8cc14, byte for byte. Version 5 (2026-11-20) adds per-site physical properties drawn from each seed by an independent stream (tests/runtime/props.py); the ranges were fixed before any site was generated with them, and no seed was replaced. Version 6 (2026-11-21) adds the changes between survey and deployment (seed bits 27, 30, 37, 43 and stream 3706) and the sensing (streams 3703, 3705), by the same rule. Version 7 (2026-11-21) gives the carried equipment and the barrier the shapes of real objects; no rule or range changed. Version 8 (2026-11-21) restores the equipment's reach with a guard frame and a crosswise profiler; the guides' rise ends at 0.112 m and friction starts at 0.45. Version 9 (2026-11-21): the set grows to sixteen with candidates 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, 14, the next eight in drawn order, all completed by the oracle; none dropped. Version 10 (2026-11-22): the cameras draw the hall (tests/runtime/hall_render.py), the rail bollards are six again, and contact follows the drawn pallet (0.144 m thick, two foot brackets) and dock mat; the same sixteen seeds, all completed by the oracle; none dropped.
